description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Grim Poppet enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
